text: Revert. We need it for the meeting. Is there a path from Bug42 to Story? Unlink Story from Backlog, and after that delete all shapes. Also, drop the wire from Backlog to Ticket9. Perfect.
Align the boxes vertically, and arrange them in a circle. Thanks.
Which shapes are crimson? Who has the most arrows? Can the most recent cyan hexagon reach the brown hexagon?
How many arrows are there? Which is the largest? Winger is a little purple ball. Copy it 3 times.
Let me see. Show the dots? Tie Button1 to Banner and Menu! Is the hexagon regular? Show me the silver squares?
Park the orange triangle between Customs and Retailer. Is that one navy? Duplicate that one 2 times! Almost done.
Is Modem connected to Router? Clear the diagram. What's on the canvas? Scoot Proxy, Vpn & Dhcp up. Almost done. Make Uplink and Wan crimson!
Wire Backlog to Epic, and Epic to Doing, then tuck the most recent orange ellipse on the right of Backlog!
Spawn a triangle alongside Manager! What color is the latest one?
Undo twice! Is the navy hexagon on the left?
Rename the first navy hexagon as Jade, and after that attach Cto to Support, and Support to Legal. Raise the newest indigo oval.
Caption all teal triangles "Refund". Because the old one was wrong. Plonk a minuscule red star!
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Place a line from Users to Research. What is closest to Metrics?
Shrink all orange circles. Which shape is the lowest? Pop a diamond at the bottom edge and then switch places of Ground and Capacitor. Who has the fewest links?
Recolour the diamonds that are not purple navy. Tidy up!
Timeline at the bottom edge! Erase the stars that are not teal, and after that inscribe "urgent" on the white star.
We are planning the next sprint. Sketch an ellipse with the name Aster. Then space all of the diamonds out in a row.
Sketch a ball! In the future all shapes are amber! What are the rules?
Change the squares that are not gold to large, and put a regular golden square saying "ok?". Are Butter and the ellipse connected? Push the balls on the right!
Is there anything on top of Motor? Arrange Capacitor, C2 and Vcc as a row. Nice.
Wire Export to Ingest and Parse! What's the bottommost one?
Which one is leftmost? Call Validate Aster, and stamp "hot" on the Archive. It should read better now. How small is the most recent grey triangle?
Are there loops? Reshape the newest aqua diamond into a hexagon. Next, shift the latest black ellipse up. Sorry, long day. Color that one silver.
Make all shapes aqua. What is the leftmost shape? Tie Banner, Card, Modal and Menu each to the next one.
I'm explaining this to my team later. How big is the Ticket9? Turn it crimson!
Scoot Parse between Enrich and Monitor. After that, paint that one orange, and then rename this one to Gizmo. After that, separate Deploy and Clean.
Stopped flows to Idle. Is the square to the right of Booting? Is it brown? Undo that!
Tell me about the last navy rectangle? What is the size of the earliest turquoise hexagon? Kill the rhombus. Almost done.
We are planning the next sprint. Make cyan squares a hexagon. Then add one square in the bottom left!
This is for tomorrow's review. Get rid of the earliest oval and exchange Header with Banner.
Relocate the earliest square by 150 upwards, and then color it gold.
What size is enrich? Drag that one left side of Loader. Is this one aqua?
note: The input has enrich in lowercase, which is the keep word; the names list has Enrich. Left as written.

text: Resize the orange rect. Is Api not green?
What color is the aqua oval? Put Icing to the centre. Ugh, messy. Clone that one 3 times!
Reset all stars which are not green, and after that tidy up. Also, add a black tiny box to the top left, and undo the last step. Perfect.
Place a purple undirected wire from Closed to Loading. Also, line up Loading and Error horizontal. Next, reset the amber rects. Then add a label "login" to the navy square!
What is downstream from the most recent hexagon? Organize vertically. We need it for the meeting. Push Intern and Finance beneath the crimson hexagon.
Push the latest hexagon to the left of Auth. What color is this one?
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Is Scene1 attached to the orange diamond? Set the shape of the black ones to square! It should read better now. What size is Scene2? Spawn a navy diamond!
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Add 12 large pink squares. Then park the Cellar in the upper right. Next, clone it 2 times.
What is the position of the new square? Tie Attic to Garage with a dash arrow. Just tidying things up a bit. Exchange Studio and Porch. After that, label the newest square 'loop'.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Recolor Verify, Submit and Reject red, and wipe the canvas! I keep losing track of things. Count the links?
Fill everything with silver, hook Sprint1 and Backlog, and put Blocked & Sprint1 between Epic and Task7.
Recolor all the blue ones brown! Blocked is average. I keep losing track of things. Move it up! Any cycles? Line up each hexagon vertically.
Show the blocks? Make every box that is not gold a box, and nudge the last purple oval between Navbar and Menu.
Slap a small pink rhombus name it Dune labeled 'no', and make the pink ones a star.
Add a caption "login" to the last black hexagon. Is it white?
We are planning the next sprint. Layout Studio and Bathroom in a line. After that, tuck Bedroom to the right of Studio, and bring it to the front!
Organise in a grid. I keep losing track of things. Organise the green hexagons in a line, and copy Shrine 3 times! Thanks!
I'm explaining this to my team later. Swamp points to Castle! Show me the connections?
Bring the earliest box in front, and lay out each rose hexagon as a column. After that, space Vpn, Rack3 & Gateway out evenly horizontal.
Attach Port to the new circle, and turn Port navy. Also, enlarge it. Nice.
Modem is right side of Gateway. Rename it to Lotus.
What's the rightmost one? Insert a line from Sensor to Resistor. Also, put a dashed line from Resistor to Coil.
We are planning the next sprint. Trash the orange triangles! Is there anything above the last star?
Let me see. List the squares that are not magenta? Push the orange balls right! Any magenta stars?
Send Whale behind! Show all triangles to the top right? How many cyan things in the center of the page?
Connect Cream and Bowl. Then sketch a square in the lower left.
Separate Recruiting from Cfo, and create eleven blocks at the top left. Next, disconnect Legal and Hr.
What text is on the star? What color is it? Is the same one yellow?
Transform the green ones into a triangle! That's the main flow. From now on, stars are rose. Is the newest lime box a triangle? Hook it to Flour.
Change Db to a tiny ball, and rename the same one to Harbor2.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Connect Idea, Metrics and Risks to the next one with a lime arrow. What can I get to from Risks? Count the links? Connect Users with Vision with an arrow.
Hmm, let me think. Delete the orange ones. Then paint all the shapes fuchsia.
Let me see. Drop the connection from Mercury to Sun, then trade Mars and Sun, and then drop the triangle.
Where is the oldest box? How many turquoise hexagons are there? How small is Mine?
Is Qb lime? Is that one orange? Sever the connector between Wr1 and Keeper.
What is downstream from Diode? What is the tiniest shape?
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Grow all green circles, join Menu, Search and Banner in a chain! Thanks!
What can I reach from Oven? Colour the elements that are not yellow lime! Almost done.
Can Task7 reach Blocked? Show me the leftmost shape? Tie Ticket9 to Testing. Slide the silver stars upwards. What is Story?
Attach Mix and Whisk to Eggs. Put Flour and Milk right side of the new indigo block. Is the most recent ball smaller than Salt? Shrink it!
Bring Bathroom to front. Connect that one to Garage, and copy the triangle six times!
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Send all of the rectangles backward. After that, line up all the diamonds in a column!
Colour all shapes white! That's the main flow. What does the scarlet rhombus link to? Pop a fuchsia triangle!
Forest just at the top! Bring it to the front. Nice.
Relocate each yellow ellipse between Toolbar and Sidebar, and nudge Button1, Menu and Logo by 60 to the right.
Call the most recent box Birch. I keep losing track of things. Plonk a turquoise ball, and nudge the teal dot 5 px up.
Get rid of the connection from S3 to Cache. How many links does Redis have?
Make all the balls that are not red large. Raise the oval. How many nodes are on the canvas? Slap a box below Milk called Cobalt!
Does Parse link to the triangle? How many navy objects do we have? Henceforth everything is navy. Remove all rules. What is right of Export?
Bedroom is a dot! Show me the rules? Put two pink squares.
What is the size of Saturn? Write "Output" on that one, and after that send earth backwards!

I'm explaining this to my team later. Place Closet, Office and Garage between Pantry and Bedroom! What are the rules? Pop a lime star with the text "no" on the right side. Next, bring the lime star to the front. We need it for the meeting. Bring this one to the front.
Make a copy of Swamp. Also, move each indigo ball between Harbor and Volcano. Overview of the diagram?
Kill all circles. How many edges does the hexagon have? Attach the new green square to Search with a dash plain line. New rects should be enormous.
Make a cyan triangle. Next, duplicate the latest one 2 times.
This is for tomorrow's review. Place a gold square right side of the turquoise rhombus. Next, bring the newest one to the front.
Copy Supplier. Because the old one was wrong. Is Retailer linked to Store?
This is for tomorrow's review. Is there anything by Firewall? Snip the wire between Ap2 and Vpn! Is there anything right side of the green rect? Add the text "x > 0" to Ap2.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Change Heron and Plankton to a big star. Plonk a ball labeled Save left of the first oval, and then forget the rules!
Place Start and Reject along the top! Verify is next to Approve. Stamp "start" on this one.
Which is the topmost? Henceforth make stars indigo.
Tuck the Pod2 down by 25 units. That's the main flow. What color is it? Nudge this one 120 px upwards!
Resize Bucket, and send that one to the back! Is it black?
Hmm, let me think. New hexagons must be brown. Convert indigo ellipses to an oval.
Discard the default rules. Change the gold hexagons to normal! What is the color of the first teal rectangle? Inscribe "Refund" on this one.
Hmm, let me think. Henceforth everything is violet! Is Source connected to Parse? Nuke everything. Then rename Export as Tango!
Change all ovals which are not blue to a big diamond! It should read better now. What can be reached from Bedroom?
Are Mercury and Orbit linked? Forget every rule. Because the old one was wrong. Label the earliest rhombus as "ok?"!
